keyword.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵目录没有活塞行程

title.en: Why Diesel 40 Concrete Pump Prints No Piston Stroke
title.zh: 为什么柴油40型混凝土泵不印活塞行程

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does print Theoretical Output 26
description.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油40型混凝土泵这一行印活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行印了理论输送量26 m³/h和最大出口压力25 MPa。活塞把混凝土排进管路，挤压泵压缩软管。目录不会靠编造行程来选定哪一种。画面「Mobile crane」的主体是Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD

h1.en: Why Diesel 40 Concrete Pump Prints No Piston Stroke
h1.zh: 为什么柴油40型混凝土泵不印活塞行程

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does print Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa. A piston displaces concrete into the line; a squeeze pump compresses a hose. The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. The frame “Mobile crane” shows Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD and adds no stroke figure.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油40型混凝土泵这一行印活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行印了理论输送量26 m³/h和最大出口压力25 MPa。活塞把混凝土排进管路，挤压泵压缩软管。目录不会靠编造行程来选定哪一种。画面「Mobile crane」的主体是Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD，也没有补上行程数字。

heading.en: Named parts are not a service procedure
heading.zh: 点出名称不等于维修步骤

body.en: The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. This Diesel 40 Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already prints. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. Main Unit Weight 2800 kg.
body.zh: 另一份易损件清单用外径列出活塞和摆臂类替换件。柴油40型混凝土泵这一行不会把那些名称变成扭矩、小时间隔，或这一行没有印出的材料牌号。料斗容积 0.4 m³。液压泵 Kawasaki 112。整机重量 2800 kg。

heading.en: The frame does not supply the missing stroke
heading.zh: 这一帧不补上缺失的行程

body.en: From en.wikipedia.org, “Mobile crane”. Subject: Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. It is not a measured stroke for Diesel 40 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 来自 en.wikipedia.org，「Mobile crane」。主体：Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD。如果画面里能看到活塞或阀，那只是这一帧的主体。它不是柴油40型混凝土泵的实测行程。

heading.zh: 保留已经印出的工作参数

body.en: Theoretical Output 26 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance cells, not from the frame and not from a different pump.
body.zh: 理论输送量26 m³/h。最大出口压力25 MPa。管路长度仍要读这个型号自己的距离格，不读这一帧，也不读另一台泵。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 Concrete Pump print a piston stroke?
question.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵印了活塞行程吗？

answer.en: Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa.
answer.zh: 理论输送量26 m³/h，最大出口压力25 MPa。

question.en: Does a piston in the frame set the stroke?
question.zh: 画面里的活塞能确定行程吗？

answer.en: No. The frame is not a stroke measurement.
answer.zh: 不能。这一帧不是行程测量。

answer.en: No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted.
answer.zh: 没有。小时、扭矩和价格都没有印。
